packageRules.description: Pin updates have no release timestamp; without this, stability-days stays pending forever. The 7-day age still applies whenever a timestamp exists
Overrides like `undici@7` are scoped to one major; a major bump would force that major on consumers that asked for the old one

Non-major updates merge themselves once every status check is green and the 7-day age has passed; majors wait for review. platformAutomerge is off because main has no branch protection, so GitHub would not wait for CI
astro check does not support TypeScript 7 yet; lift this cap once @astrojs/check does
